speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) in the last three years, how many policy holders had their Home Protection Scheme (HPS) cover lapse because of failure to pay the premiums; (b) how many appeal cases were there from family members claiming HPS benefits upon the HPS member's death or cancellation of the insurance shortly before death; (c) whether measures are taken to ensure that HPS members know the consequences of lapsed insurance and, if so, what are these measures; and (d) whether there are plans to make HPS compulsory for HDB homeowners, including those with pre-existing medical conditions.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: In such a situation, HPS will help to defray the outstanding mortgage of the home, hence, enabling surviving family members to continue to live in their flats.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: HDB flat owners who do not use their CPF savings to pay for their mortgage can take up HPS on a voluntary basis.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: So, we see a decreasing trend over the years.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: These appeals were considered on a case-by-case basis.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: One, at the point of flat purchase, HDB explains to flat buyers the benefits and coverage of HPS.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Two, subsequently, HPS premiums are automatically deducted from the flat owners' CPF Ordinary Account (OA).

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Flat owners can also use their co-owners' OA savings to pay for their HPS premiums if they themselves do not have sufficient OA savings.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: If members miss their premium payment, CPF Board sends them a notification within one week, reminding them to pay their premium and, if necessary, a second notification after one month, informing the members that HPS claims are not possible if their policy lapses.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: If premiums are not paid within the two-month grace period, CPF Board sends a letter notifying members that their policy has lapsed and the letter also requests them to re-apply for HPS.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: For members who are required to take up HPS but their policy has lapsed, CPF Board will continue to send them letters every six months reminding them to re-apply for HPS.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: So, there is a continuous measure to keep reminding members who had lapsed on HPS to re-apply so that they can enjoy the coverage.
